verdict.rationale: Connecting a coding agent to workflow tools is a fair question for this kind of product, but the evidence pack documents no Jira, Slack, Google Drive, or other workflow-tool connectors, and no MCP-client support. The closest feature is the generic /web page scraper, which is an adjacent capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the agent to workflow tools like Jira, Slack, and Google Drive to extend its context
